key_claims.claim: AI assistance during real-time prenatal ultrasound significantly improved sonographer detection of fetal intracranial malformations compared to unassisted scanning.

Umbilical artery Doppler classification effectively stratified selective fetal growth restriction severity and predicted adverse outcomes in monochorionic pregnancies, though most cases were the milder Type I phenotype.
The OccuNet AI model detected radiograph-negative femoral neck fractures with accuracy matching radiologists and exceeding emergency physicians across four external validation sites.
Ketamine plus midazolam reduced intraprocedural pain compared to fentanyl plus midazolam during interventional radiology procedures.
Commercial AI for pulmonary nodule assessment modestly reduced radiologist reading time in real-world practice at a single tertiary center.
